reviewNotes:
【English】
OnTime Clock is a time utility for people waiting for a ticket or product sale to open. It shows a countdown based on the public time of the platform the user selects. It does not buy anything, simulate taps or access any platform account.

No login or demo account is needed. All user data stays on the device.

How to test:
1. On first launch, agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy, then tap Skip on the guide.
2. Tap + on the home screen, enter a name, pick a start time within the next 8 hours and save. A real link is not required.
3. On the sale's card, tap "Floating window", then leave the app. The floating clock appears over other apps.
4. To see Membership, tap the yellow "Go Premium" button next to the avatar on the Me tab, or try to add a 4th sale.

In-app purchases: Lifetime (one-time, CNY 18) and Quarterly (auto-renewing, CNY 8 per 3 months). Free users get all features with up to 3 sales at a time. Members get unlimited sales and the ad-free benefit. The app currently shows no ads to anyone; ads may be added to the free version later. "Restore purchases" is at the top right of the Membership page.

Picture in Picture and background audio: the floating clock uses system Picture in Picture and renders the clock as video frames. It uses AVPictureInPictureVideoCallViewController so the system shows only the close and return buttons, without playback controls. This is not a real video call. It starts only when the user turns it on. The audio background mode and playback session (mixed with other audio) are used so countdown beeps can sound while the user is in another app, if they turn on Countdown sound. The app does not play continuous audio.

Reading a link: only when the user pastes or scans a link from a listed sale platform, the app opens that one public page in a hidden web view with no login and no saved cookies, reads the title and start time, and shows them for the user to confirm. It stops at captcha or login pages and the user enters the time manually.

Time sync: reads only the current time from a public NTP service and public platform time endpoints. No user data is sent.

Permissions, each requested only when the feature is used: Calendar (From calendar, reads upcoming events on the device for the user to pick), Camera (scan QR code, avatar photo), Photos (QR image, avatar), Notifications (sale reminders and alarm tones). Live Activities show the countdown on Dynamic Island and the Lock Screen.

Feedback uses a Tencent Questionnaire web form, which receives a random user ID, membership type and app version when opened.

【中文】
准点时钟是抢票、抢购用的时间工具，按用户选的平台公开时间显示倒计时。不代抢、不模拟点击、不访问任何平台账号。不需要登录，也不需要演示账号，数据只保存在手机上。

测试方法：首次打开同意协议，引导点「跳过」；点首页「+」，填名称和 8 小时内的开抢时间并保存，不需要真实链接；点卡片上的「开启悬浮窗」后退出 App，悬浮时钟显示在其他 App 上方。

会员入口：「我的」头像右侧的黄色按钮，或添加第 4 场时弹出。永久会员 18 元（一次购买），季度会员 8 元（每 3 个月自动续订）。免费用户可用全部功能，最多同时 3 场；会员不限场次，并享全程无广告。App 现在对所有人都不显示广告，以后免费版可能接入广告。恢复购买在会员页右上角。

悬浮窗使用系统画中画，把时钟画成视频帧；使用通话式画中画接口是为了只显示关闭和回到 App 两个按钮，并不是真实通话，只在用户开启时启动。后台音频用于用户打开「倒计时声音」后，在其他 App 里也能响提示音，和其他音频混合，不持续播放音频。

读链接：只在用户粘贴或扫码时，用隐藏网页打开这一个公开页面，不登录、不留 Cookie，读到标题和开抢时间后先让用户确认；遇到验证码或登录页就放弃，由用户手填。权限（日历、相机、相册、通知）都只在用到时申请。
